summary: Verified the new content-edit + global-search feature bundle end-to-end. Backend: added 7 new pytest cases covering PUT /api/drawings/{id}, /api/writings/{id}, /api/videos/{id}, /api/messages/{id} — auth-gate (401 without JWT), partial-update semantics (only supplied fields change, others preserved), 404 on unknown id, 400 on empty body, and public GET reflects updates. All 37 backend tests pass (30 prior + 7 new). Frontend: signed in as admin via /api/site/verify-password, injected JWT into localStorage keys 'delined-admin-token' + 'admin-token'. Verified: (a) /admin panel renders 'edit' buttons with data-testid='edit-drawing-{id}' for each row, clicking opens EditContentDialog with pre-filled values, editing + Save PUTs to /api/drawings/{id}, dialog closes, DB reflects the change (confirmed via API round-trip); (b) /drawings shows inline '✎ edit' button (data-testid='inline-edit-drawing-{id}') on the selected item when admin — opens the same dialog; (c) drifter (no admin token) does NOT see inline-edit-drawing-{id} on /drawings; (d) Hub at /home has data-testid='hub-search-input' + 'hub-search-submit' — typing 'rabbit' + submit navigates to /search?q=rabbit with query pre-populated in the SearchResults input; (e) navigating to /search?q=%23uitest surfaces a card data-testid='search-drawing-{id}' matching only by tag, clicking it lands on /drawings with the correct item pre-selected via location.state.selectId; (f) /search with empty q shows the 'type a query' prompt rather than a zero-results message. Site-gate password endpoint verified on preview: drifter password '$T4r7newS4V3' returns 200/role=drifter with NO token; admin password returns 200/role=admin + JWT + user; wrong password 401 — the user-reported prod breakage is production-side only, no code fix needed on preview.

issues: When there are results in only one section the empty-state 'no results…' text still shows when total==0 for an empty section flip; not a bug — verified copy behaves correctly, only listing for visual audit.

action_items: None — all requested features work on preview. If the visitor password ($T4r7newS4V3) is still failing in production, redeploy so the ENV var SITE_PASSWORD picks up the current value; the code + preview both accept it.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_drawing/writing/video/message all follow the same pattern (payload = model_dump(exclude_none=True); 400 if empty; 404 on matched_count==0; return doc). Consider DRYing into a helper like `partial_update(collection, id, payload)` — minor.

EditContentDialog: reads JWT from localStorage directly instead of via AuthContext — inconsistent with AdminPanel which uses useAuth().token. Works because tokens are mirrored on both keys, but a single source of truth would be cleaner.
EditContentDialog: swallows all errors with a single toast(e?.response?.data?.detail || 'save failed') — no console.error for debugging; would be helpful.

SearchResults.jsx: on click of a card it always Link-navigates to the plural route (/drawings, /writings, /videos) with state.selectId. Drawings.jsx honors this in its `load()` — but if the user is ALREADY on /drawings and clicks a search link to the same page, load() runs on mount only. Not blocking for the current UX (search page → target) but worth noting.
Hub.jsx form submit navigates to /search?q=... even if hubQuery is empty after trim() (guarded); good. But there is no data-testid on the tips paragraph — minor testability nit.
Backend PUT /messages allows admins to edit sender name/email — intended per MessageUpdate model; ensure operator understands this bypasses the original submission audit trail.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 6 flows PASS (hub-search nav, admin-panel edit drawing, inline edit /drawings, search #tag + click nav, empty-query prompt, drifter cannot see edit)
